name: Outlaw
description: You rejected — or were rejected by — Aslan society and forge your own path in the criminal sphere. Pirates, like Outcasts, privately nurse a desire to return to normal Aslan society but see little chance for success.

pirate.name: Pirate
pirate.description: You attack shipping and the colonies of other, lesser races.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: You attack outlying settlements and vulnerable lesser clans.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: You work alone and steal from the wealthy.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You are captured and punished by the clan you stole from. Reduce your END -2, and gain a member of that clan as an Enemy.
mishaps.3: A rival outlaw band attacks. Roll on the Injury table and lose any Benefit rolls from this term.
mishaps.4: You are forced to flee off-planet. Gain Deception 1, Pilot 1, Independence 1 or Streetwise 1 as you flee.
mishaps.5: A friend betrays you. One Ally or Contact becomes a Rival (if you have no Contacts or Allies, then you never saw the betrayal coming; gain a Rival anyway).
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table.
events.3: You barely survive on the fringes of Aslan space. Lose END −1, but gain any one skill.
events.4: One of your crimes pays off. Gain a Benefit roll.
events.5: A clan puts a price on your head. Gain an Enemy and Stealth 1, Streetwise 1, Gun Combat 1 or Survival 1. Alternatively, you can try to claim the reward yourself: roll Deception 8+. Succeed and gain 3 Benefit rolls. Fail and you are recognised — lose END −2 and you are ejected from this career.
events.6: You acquire a contact in the criminal sphere. Gain a Contact.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You pick up some useful skills. Gain Electronics 1, Independence 1, Stealth 1 or Gun Combat 1.
events.9: You attempt an audacious raid on a rival. Roll either Pilot 8+, Stealth 8+ or Gun Combat 8+. Fail and you must roll on the Injury table. Succeed and you gain an extra Benefit roll or SOC +1.
events.10: You are offered employment by a clan to perform some deed that they want accomplished covertly. If you accept, roll Stealth 8+. Fail and you gain nothing. Succeed and you gain an extra Benefit roll. Alternatively, you can inform the clan's enemies; gain a Benefit roll but also gain the clan as an Enemy.
events.11: If male, you have the opportunity to reclaim your standing in society. Gain TER +1 and restore your SOC but you must leave this career after this term. If female and unmarried, you may marry a male of good family. If you accept, reroll your SOC and you leave this career after this term.
events.12: Your deeds are the stuff of legends and nightmares. You are automatically promoted.

mustering_dm_notes: DM+1 if male when rolling on Benefits column.
